title: Gradients describe a local change
summary: A gradient describes how an output changes near the current input. GradientTape records operations so TensorFlow can calculate a derivative.
introduction: A gradient describes how an output changes near the current input. GradientTape records operations so TensorFlow can calculate a derivative. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain gradients describe a local change
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A gradient describes how an output changes near the current input. GradientTape records operations so TensorFlow can calculate a derivative.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.Variable(3.0)
with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
    y = x * x
print(float(tape.gradient(y, x).numpy()))
blocks.title: Gradients describe a local change

blocks.text: The result is 6.0. For x squared, the derivative at x is 2 times x, so at 3 it is 6.
